module "OutputsExpression.dsm"

product 0 Material "M_LiOutputsExpression" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 0.5, 0.25, 1), ParameterName="Tint", SortPriority=32) : float4 @L8:C9 "Tint"
  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L17:C22 "Color"
  %2 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L17:C33 "Color"
  %3 = Multiply(%1, %2) : float3 @L17:C22 "Color"
  %4 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.5), ParameterName="Glow", SortPriority=32) : float @L7:C9 "Glow"
  %5 = Multiply(%3, %4) : float3 @L12:C30 "EmissiveColor"
  %6 = Constant(Value=(2)) : float @L13:C40 "Opacity"
  %7 = Multiply(%4, %6) : float @L13:C33 "Opacity"
  %8 = Saturate(%7) : float @L13:C24 "Opacity"
  %9 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%5, Opacity=%8) @L4:C1
  sink %9
